Officer's narrative
Officers responded to a side-impact collision at an intersection in Conroe, Texas. Driver 1 was traveling through the
intersection when Driver 2 entered from a crossing street and struck the driver's side of the vehicle. Driver 1 is the
listed policy holder on the vehicle involved. Driver 1 reported pain in the right shoulder and was evaluated at the
scene. The injury description is consistent with the force of a lateral impact of this kind. A Passenger was also in the
vehicle, and both officers and independent witnesses confirmed their presence at the time of the crash. Driver 2 gave
a statement that matched the sequence described by Driver 1, and two witnesses provided accounts of the collision
that agree with each other. Photographs taken at the scene show damage to the driver's side panels and door that
corresponds with the reported point of impact. No prior damage to the vehicle was known to officers or reported by
any party. Both vehicles were towed from the scene, and no further action was taken at this time pending review.
</page>
